title: Petra and the Semester
author: Ada Almeida
blurb: Beatrix Ishikawa, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must expose what the school board buried, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
